question:
**Direction: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A group of people, typically with vehicles or animals, travelling together
solution:
The correct answer is **"Caravan."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Caravan"** is a noun that means a group of people, typically with vehicles or animals, travelling together. (यात्रियों और पशुओं का दल जो एक साथ मिलकर सफ़र करते हैं; कारवाँ, क़ाफि़ला)

 
 
• **Example**: *The **caravan**__ of traders traveled through the desert.*
 
 
 
• It is a one-word substitute for **"a group of people, typically with vehicles or animals, travelling together."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: Alibi** is a noun that means an excuse or defense used to avoid blame or punishment. (अपराध के समय अन्‍यत्र उपस्थित होने का कथन (यह सिद्ध करने के लिए की वह दोषी नहीं है); अन्‍यत्रता)
 
• **Option 2: Anachronism **is a noun that means something or someone that is not in its correct historical or chronological time. (पुरातनपंथी व्‍यक्ति या व्‍यवहार जो वर्तमान में अजीब लगे)
 
• **Option 4: Bohemian** is a noun that means a person who is unconventional and free-spirited. (एक व्यक्ति जो अपरंपरागत और स्वतंत्र विचारों वाला है)
